observation: In the frozen field 23 encounter, the shared C++ battle reconstruction reproduces the exact exit memory image and resident rand state from each original entry image for every captured call: all four party attacks (80085ccc, each dealing 15 damage), all four result applications that knock out the four enemies (80085618), all six alive-mask updates (8007252c) including the victory, all 2,080 per-frame ATB ticks (8007171c) and 4 turn-timer reloads (800718bc), the victory reward totals (801e2280 up to its UI call) and the reward call 801e2794, whose experience split, level-up with rand stat growth, skill checks and write-back change all 11 persistent character records. No comparison diverged.
interpretation: Command commit, target iteration, formula dispatch, the physical damage formula, result application with knockout bookkeeping, victory detection, reward totals, the experience split and level-ups, and the write-back of battle results to persistent party state run as recovered source over battle memory and the resident game data, both owned by original address. The route exercises party physical attacks only and its enemies carry no gold or drops; enemy AI, other formula types, defeat, escape, gold addition and drop addition are source-reconstructed or source-mapped without route observation.
author: Claude Opus 5.5, integration owner
reviewers: Independent instruction-level review of every reconstructed battle function, jump table and ownership boundary against the overlay listing and a route RAM dump (review-battle-actions.md): no blocking defects; the unguarded divide at 800972b0 now reproduces the R3000A quotient, and the resident table read at 80096b5c fails by name.

Independent instruction-level review of result application, victory detection, reward totals, experience split, level-ups, stat growth, skills, write-back, drop rolls and drop addition, and of the battle and game-data ownership (review-battle-rewards.md): no blocking defects; the game-data overlap check now rejects partial overlaps.
Independent instruction-level review of the ATB tick, turn-timer reload, timer value and party flag balance (review-battle-turns.md): no defects.

validation.expected: Exact original exit memory image for every owned byte and every original-changed byte outside the callee stack window and interrupt-only bytes; exact GTE state and return value; explicit stops for unrecovered behavior.
validation.actual: 11 comparison reports, 2,100 calls, 0 divergences, 0 stops. All 26 C++ and repository tests pass in debug and sanitize presets; repository checks pass.
validation.tolerance: None beyond the documented exclusions: callee stack window 0x800 bytes below the entry stack pointer, the scratchpad, and bytes changed only by bracketed interrupt handlers (plus BIOS exception save areas while they ran).

limitations: Per-call equivalence from original entry images; the turn scheduler, ATB timers, menu input, the frame loop and the result screens are not reconstructed.
Only formula type 0 is reconstructed; the gear resolver 8009c198 and character 4 item bookkeeping 8009afd8 fail explicitly.

Enemies never act on this route and carry no gold or drops: enemy AI 800799c8, enemy formulas, defeat, escape, gold addition and drop addition are not observed. The field return after battle remains required work.
